notes.tone: Four men who have each lost a table to the player, now at one table together. Warmer than their home tables: they know the player's name, and most of the comedy is between them. Death is still the only dry voice.
notes.difficulty: respectStart is 2. The player arrives known by name; tiers 0 and 1 exist so the schema is complete and are rarely heard. Tier 3 is the real climb.
notes.place: The Hall of Doors — Death's own hall, where the doors of every table on the tour meet. It must look like the destination (the red herring): grand by scale and impossible geometry, not by gold. The small plain ninth door is the finale; nobody ever mentions it.
notes.champion_lines: champion is null. champion_headsup holds one headsup_start and one player_wins_pot line PER CHAMPION: play the one whose speaker is the player's last opponent. Untriggered heads-up lines should only fire when their speaker is the one still seated. champion_defeat: play the concession of whoever was beaten last, then Death's line.
notes.odysseus_skip: If the player skipped Odysseus at Athens, he has never actually played them. Every line here is written to be true either way ('lost a table to you', never 'lost to you'). If the engine ever supports a condition, a one-off skip-branch line for Odysseus's first hand: "So you are the one who emptied my table before I could sit down. I have been looking forward to this."
notes.dealer_plant: The single 'the dealer arranged it' line for this table is c1_plant_02. Washington says it, as he did at the White House. Do NOT add a second.
notes.leak_rule: No line may reference hand strength while cards are live.
notes.voice: All four champions + Death are voiced.

respect_tiers.0: Contempt. Rarely reached here — every one of them has lost a table to the player. Not addressed by any name.
respect_tiers.1: Grudging. They put the first win down to luck: 'Lucky'.
respect_tiers.2: Starting tier. Real address — they know the player's name, having lost to it.
respect_tiers.3: Title. Washington gives it first, as he gave the first title of the tour: 'Champion'.

table_intro.speaker: death
table_intro.text: Eight doors, one for every table on the tour. Tonight four of them stand open, and the champions have come through their own.

table_intro.speaker: death
table_intro.text: This is the grandest room I keep. I am told it is very impressive. I would not know; I am usually looking at the cards.
table_intro.foreshadow: The red herring: the grandest room reads as the destination. True — it is the grandest he keeps. It is not the only one.

table_intro.speaker: death
table_intro.text: Each of them has lost a table to you. They have come to find out whether that was you, or the cards. Sit down.

dealer_plant.speaker: odysseus
dealer_plant.text: Two kings, a general and a pirate, and the same stranger has emptied all four of our tables. Did none of you think to ask who sent for our friend here?

dealer_plant.speaker: washington
dealer_plant.note: The same four words he said at the White House. He was the first to say them on the tour; he is the only one who needs to say them here.

dealer_plant.speaker: blackbeard
dealer_plant.note: THE SHRUG. The most fearless man at the table will not question the dealer. The player never gets an answer.

washington_arthur.relationship: One man refused a crown — in 1782 Washington angrily rebuffed a suggestion that he make himself king, and he gave up power twice. The other wore one, and lost his kingdom to the men at his own table. Deep mutual respect, conducted in very few words.

exchanges.speaker: arthur
exchanges.text: They tell me you were offered a crown, General, and refused it.

exchanges.speaker: washington
exchanges.text: I did.

exchanges.speaker: arthur
exchanges.text: Wise. It is heavier than it looks.

exchanges.speaker: arthur
exchanges.text: You gave up your army, General, and later the presidency. Did no one ask you to stay?

exchanges.speaker: washington
exchanges.text: They asked.

exchanges.speaker: arthur
exchanges.text: ...Nobody ever asked me to leave. I rather wish someone had.

exchanges.speaker: arthur
exchanges.text: You never wanted a table of your own, General?

exchanges.speaker: washington
exchanges.text: I wanted a farm.

exchanges.speaker: arthur
exchanges.text: And did you get it?

exchanges.speaker: washington
exchanges.text: Twice.
exchanges.note: He went home to Mount Vernon in 1783 after resigning his commission, and again in 1797 after declining a third term.

needles.speaker: washington
needles.text: Your Majesty.

needles.speaker: arthur
needles.text: General. Well taken.

needles.speaker: arthur
needles.text: You yield, General?

needles.speaker: washington
needles.text: I know when to.

blackbeard_odysseus.relationship: Two sailors whose reputations were built on tricks: the man of the wooden horse and the man with smoke in his beard. Odysseus took ten years to get home across the sea; Blackbeard regards that as a navigation problem.

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: Ten years to sail home? I'd have hanged the navigator.

exchanges.speaker: odysseus
exchanges.text: I was the navigator.

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: ...Then I'd have hanged you.

exchanges.speaker: odysseus
exchanges.text: A god tried. You would have to wait your turn.

exchanges.speaker: odysseus
exchanges.text: The smoke in your beard. The pistols on the table. Theatre, surely.

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: Theatre that took ships without a shot fired. What did your wooden horse ever take?

exchanges.speaker: odysseus
exchanges.text: Troy.

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: You had your men tie you to the mast. Just to hear some singing.

exchanges.speaker: odysseus
exchanges.text: You would have done the same.

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: ...Aye. I would.

exchanges.speaker: odysseus
exchanges.text: Tell me how you really died, Captain.

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: Five pistol balls and twenty cuts, and I was still reaching for a pistol.

exchanges.speaker: odysseus
exchanges.text: Twenty! A good story.

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: It's true.

exchanges.speaker: odysseus
exchanges.text: That's never stopped me.

needles.speaker: blackbeard
needles.text: Folded! The great tactician runs for his boat.

needles.speaker: odysseus
needles.text: I always run for my boat. It's why I'm still alive. Relatively speaking.

needles.speaker: odysseus
needles.text: Well! The terror of the Carolinas, backing water.

needles.speaker: blackbeard
needles.text: Enjoy it. I'll be coming about.

arthur_odysseus.relationship: Two kings who left home for a war. Penelope held Ithaca against a houseful of suitors for twenty years; Arthur left Britain in Mordred's keeping. One of them made the better arrangement, and both of them know which.

exchanges.speaker: arthur
exchanges.text: Twenty years from home, Odysseus. Who kept your kingdom for you?

exchanges.speaker: odysseus
exchanges.text: My wife. Against a houseful of suitors, with a loom.

exchanges.speaker: arthur
exchanges.text: I left mine with Mordred.

exchanges.speaker: odysseus
exchanges.text: Ithaca is rock and goats. But it is still mine.

exchanges.speaker: arthur
exchanges.text: Camelot had towers, and banners, and the finest knights in Christendom.

exchanges.speaker: odysseus
exchanges.text: And where is it now?

exchanges.speaker: arthur
exchanges.text: ...Rock and goats, I should think.

exchanges.speaker: odysseus
exchanges.text: They say you'll come again, Arthur. When Britain needs you.

exchanges.speaker: arthur
exchanges.text: They say so.

exchanges.speaker: odysseus
exchanges.text: I came again. It took twenty years, and then I had to deal with everyone in my house.

exchanges.speaker: arthur
exchanges.text: ...Perhaps I will wait a little longer.

needles.speaker: arthur
needles.text: You yielded, Odysseus.

needles.speaker: odysseus
needles.text: Strategically. I'll be back. Eventually. Possibly in disguise.

needles.speaker: odysseus
needles.text: The king of the Britons, folding to a goatherd from Ithaca.

needles.speaker: arthur
needles.text: A king of Ithaca. I have been beaten by worse men, at my own table.

washington_blackbeard.relationship: In 1718 Blackbeard blockaded Charles Town, South Carolina, took hostages, and ransomed them for a chest of medicine. The same year, the Governor of Virginia sent the sloops that killed him. Washington is a Virginian, and the colonies Blackbeard robbed became the country Washington founded.

exchanges.speaker: washington
exchanges.text: You blockaded Charleston.

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: It was the King's town then, not yours.

exchanges.speaker: washington
exchanges.text: It is not the King's now.

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: ...So I heard.

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: You're a Virginian, General.

exchanges.speaker: washington
exchanges.text: I am.

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: Virginia sent the sloops that killed me.

exchanges.speaker: washington
exchanges.text: I know.

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: A general who forbade swearing in his camp, they tell me.

exchanges.speaker: washington
exchanges.text: I did.

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: Damn.

exchanges.speaker: washington
exchanges.text: [looks at him]

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: ...Sorry, General.
exchanges.note: True: Washington issued general orders against 'profane cursing, swearing and drunkenness' in the Continental Army (1776).

needles.speaker: washington
needles.text: Strike your colours, Captain.

needles.speaker: blackbeard
needles.text: Ha! To a Virginian. I'll never hear the end of it.

needles.speaker: blackbeard
needles.text: Ha! I made the General back down!

needles.speaker: washington
needles.text: You made me fold. It is not the same.

washington_odysseus.relationship: The man history remembers for refusing to lie, and the man literature remembers for lying beautifully. The cherry-tree story was invented after Washington's death by a biographer, which Odysseus finds professionally admirable. Washington does not find it anything.

exchanges.speaker: odysseus
exchanges.text: They say you could not tell a lie, General.

exchanges.speaker: washington
exchanges.text: They say a great many things.

exchanges.speaker: odysseus
exchanges.text: I could teach you. It is a very useful skill.

exchanges.speaker: washington
exchanges.text: No.

exchanges.speaker: washington
exchanges.text: Twenty years away from home.

exchanges.speaker: odysseus
exchanges.text: Ten at the war, ten getting back.

exchanges.speaker: washington
exchanges.text: I was eight years at mine. I did not get lost.

exchanges.speaker: odysseus
exchanges.text: Nor did I. I was delayed.

needles.speaker: washington
needles.text: You retreat.

needles.speaker: odysseus
needles.text: I withdraw, General. As you did from Long Island, and you won the war.

needles.speaker: washington
needles.text: [inclines his head: the point is conceded]

needles.speaker: odysseus
needles.text: The Father of His Country folds! I'll tell it bigger when I get home.

needles.speaker: washington
needles.text: I expect you will.

arthur_blackbeard.relationship: Blackbeard sailed a ship named for a queen of Britain and robbed her subjects from it. Arthur was king of Britain before there was an England to rob. Neither thinks much of the other's idea of loyalty, and both are enjoying it.

exchanges.speaker: arthur
exchanges.text: You named your ship for a queen of Britain, Captain.

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: Queen Anne. Dead by then. She didn't mind.

exchanges.speaker: arthur
exchanges.text: I would have minded.

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: A round table. So nobody sits at the head of it.

exchanges.speaker: arthur
exchanges.text: So that no knight is above another.

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: On my ship everyone knew who sat at the head. I shot the ones who forgot.

exchanges.speaker: arthur
exchanges.text: And did your crew love you?

exchanges.speaker: blackbeard
exchanges.text: ...They were very punctual.

needles.speaker: arthur
needles.text: Yield, pirate.

needles.speaker: blackbeard
needles.text: Just this once, your Majesty. Don't tell the crew.

needles.speaker: blackbeard
needles.text: Ha! The king strikes his colours!

needles.speaker: arthur
needles.text: Kings fold, Captain. Only pirates think they must win every fight.

tier_0.speaker: odysseus
tier_0.text: Troy fell to a wooden horse. It does not follow that the horse could play cards.

tier_1.speaker: blackbeard
tier_1.text: Deal Lucky in, then. Luck's a tide. It goes out.

tier_1.speaker: odysseus
tier_1.text: Fortune has favourites. I was one, once. Then I spent ten years at sea.

tier_2.speaker: arthur
tier_2.text: {name}! Sit, and be welcome. Every one of us has lost a table to you; it makes for easy conversation.

tier_2.speaker: blackbeard
tier_2.text: I've told the story of that night at the cove a dozen times now. In most of them, I win.

tier_2.speaker: odysseus
tier_2.text: You arrived on time. I have always admired that in other people.

tier_3.speaker: washington
tier_3.note: Washington gave the player the first title of the tour ('Challenger') in one word. He gives this one the same way.

tier_3.speaker: arthur
tier_3.text: Kings used to ride a long way to sit at my table, {title}. I would ride a long way to sit at yours.

tier_3.speaker: blackbeard
tier_3.text: If you ever want a ship, {title}, I'll give you the best one I ever stole. Don't tell the crew.

tier_3.speaker: odysseus
tier_3.text: There is always one more shore before home, {title}. I would know. Do not stop at this one.
tier_3.foreshadow: Sounds like a sailor's homily. There is one more shore: the dock house on the near bank.

death_asides.speaker: death
death_asides.text: Take your time. Everyone at this table has had theirs.

death_asides.speaker: death
death_asides.text: The deck has no idea who any of them are. I have always admired that about it.

death_asides.speaker: death
death_asides.text: Champions leave the way everyone else does. I have watched both.

death_asides.speaker: death
death_asides.text: They called it luck last time. They are going to need a better word.

death_asides.speaker: death
death_asides.text: Look at them. Legends, every one, and not one of them knows what to do about you.

death_asides.speaker: death
death_asides.text: All of it, in the middle. I have watched people do that with more than chips.

death_asides.speaker: death
death_asides.text: Two left. This is the part people remember.

champion_headsup.speaker: washington
champion_headsup.note: Callback to his first heads-up line at the White House.

champion_headsup.speaker: odysseus
champion_headsup.text: Just the two of us. I have been in smaller boats with worse company.

champion_headsup.speaker: blackbeard
champion_headsup.text: Just you and me. I've been waiting for this since you cleaned me out in my own cove.

champion_headsup.speaker: arthur
champion_headsup.text: Two left. It was always going to come to single combat.

champion_headsup.speaker: odysseus
champion_headsup.text: Well! I did not see that coming. That is supposed to be my line of work.

champion_headsup.speaker: blackbeard
champion_headsup.text: Ha! Take it. I'll have it back with interest.

champion_headsup.speaker: arthur
champion_headsup.text: Merlin would have seen that coming. I am rather glad he is not here.

champion_headsup.speaker: washington
champion_headsup.text: I once crossed a river at night, in a storm. It went better than anyone expected.
champion_headsup.foreshadow: The Delaware, Christmas night 1776, before Trenton. Also an exact description of where the player is going next.

champion_headsup.speaker: odysseus
champion_headsup.text: You should know that I lie. Possibly including just now.

champion_headsup.speaker: blackbeard
champion_headsup.text: They say only the Devil and I know where my treasure's buried. He's never told, and neither will I.

champion_headsup.speaker: arthur
champion_headsup.text: A round table. I am flattered, dealer — or mocked. With you, one can never tell.

washington.speaker: washington
washington.text: Enough. I know when to step down.

washington.speaker: washington
washington.text: I have given up greater things than a chair.

odysseus.speaker: odysseus
odysseus.text: I will find my way back. It may take some years.

odysseus.speaker: odysseus
odysseus.text: Well. I have been shipwrecked before. This is drier.

blackbeard.speaker: blackbeard
blackbeard.text: Put me ashore, then. I've done it to better men.

arthur.speaker: arthur
arthur.text: I yield. It is not a word I have had much practice with.

arthur.speaker: arthur
arthur.text: Keep my seat. They always say I will come back.

player_busted.speaker: blackbeard
player_busted.text: Back to the longboat with you. Come again when you've found your sea legs.

player_busted.speaker: arthur
player_busted.text: Go on. Every one of our tables has fallen to you once. They can fall again.

player_busted.speaker: death
player_busted.text: The champions will wait. Waiting is most of what they do now.

champion_defeat.speaker: washington
champion_defeat.text: Twice. Then it was not luck.

champion_defeat.speaker: odysseus
champion_defeat.text: I have lost to cleverer opponents — no. No, I have not.

champion_defeat.speaker: blackbeard
champion_defeat.text: The first time I lost, they hung my head from a bowsprit. You've only ever taken my chips. I'll call that manners.

champion_defeat.speaker: arthur
champion_defeat.text: Well played. I once had a table full of better knights than myself. It is good to be reminded what that was like.

champion_defeat.speaker: death
champion_defeat.text: Nine. The other four have been listening at their doors.
